title: 🗂️ Session manager — autosave
help: Debounced ~2 seconds after any change, AgentCase writes the current configuration into this browser's IndexedDB, keyed to the tab that's open. Reloading that same tab reads it back and offers to restore. Every tab gets its own record, so several cases open in several tabs never overwrite each other — a small "🗂 N other sessions" indicator in the top bar surfaces the others without interrupting whatever you're doing.

Local to this browser and this file's origin only — never uploaded, never synced across devices. Capped at the 20 most recently-saved sessions; older ones are pruned automatically. Toggle autosave off, or clear this tab's own session, at any time from the panel above.
